goal: Add rate limiting to the public API and prove it works.

tasks.title: Map the request path
tasks.prompt: Find where public API requests enter the app and which middleware runs. List files and line numbers.

tasks.title: Design the limiter
tasks.prompt: Propose the rate limiter: data shape, where it hooks in, limits, failure behaviour. One page.

tasks.title: Implement the limiter
tasks.prompt: Implement the design. Keep the diff small.

tasks.title: Test the limiter
tasks.prompt: Write behaviour tests for the limiter and run them.

tasks.title: Document the limits
tasks.prompt: Document the limits and the 429 response in the API docs.

tasks.title: Review the change
tasks.prompt: Review the diff for bugs. Report only problems you can demonstrate.
